Class NetComponent

java.lang.Object
pl.AWTGameEngine.components.base.ObjectComponent
pl.AWTGameEngine.components.net.base.NetComponent
Direct Known Subclasses:
Base3DShape, BlankRenderer, Client, Movement2D, NetServer, PlayerSpawner, Prefab, RelayClient, SpriteRenderer, SteamRelayClient, TextRenderer
public abstract class NetComponent extends ObjectComponent
NetComponent is a class which inherits from ObjectComponent and contains events which are common for components which works in the network (e.g. onClientConnect, onSynchronize, onNetUpdate).

Available events:
  • onClientConnect(Server, NetConnection)
  • onClientDisconnect(Server, NetConnection)
  • onClientTryToConnect(String)
  • onSynchronize()
  • onSynchronizeReceived(String)
  • onNetUpdate()
  • canSynchronize()
  • clearNetCache()

    • onClientTryToConnect

      public String onClientTryToConnect(String clientIdentifier)
      Event is fired when client tries to connect and after max client check is fired. You can check authentication, blacklist or whitelist here. Return null to let the client in, or return a string, to send a message to the client.
      Parameters:
      clientIdentifier - Client IP address if you're using StandardNetConnection, or SteamID (long) if you're using SteamNetConnection
      Returns:
      null or join-disconnect message

      public boolean canSynchronize()
      Before component synchronization, canSynchronize() will be fired. Here you can check cache, if the component was updated.
      Returns:
      State if component can be synchronized

    • clearNetCache

      public void clearNetCache()
      Method is called when net cache should be cleared (e.g. new client connected). You can change here, for example, a boolean which points if the component was updated.
